hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Aggregate Friday purchases in November 2023 for Premium and vip memberships, preserving zeroes for inactive combinations.

hints.title: Grid Construction
hints.text: Generate all four Fridays in November 2023 and cross join with the target membership tiers to form complete pairs.

hints.title: Left Join and Aggregation
hints.text: Left join the calendar grid with filtered purchases and users. Replace null sums with zero and order by week of month and membership.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Fridays AS (
    SELECT 1 AS week_of_month, '2023-11-03' AS purchase_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT week_of_month + 1, DATE_ADD(purchase_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) 
    FROM Fridays 
    WHERE week_of_month < 4
), 
Memberships AS (
    SELECT 'Premium' AS membership
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT 'VIP' AS membership
)
SELECT 
    Fridays.week_of_month, 
    Memberships.membership, 
    IFNULL(SUM(Purchases.amount_spend), 0) AS total_amount 
FROM Fridays 
CROSS JOIN Memberships 
LEFT JOIN Users 
    ON Memberships.membership = Users.membership
LEFT JOIN Purchases 
    ON Fridays.purchase_date = Purchases.purchase_date 
    AND Users.user_id = Purchases.user_id
GROUP BY Fridays.week_of_month, Memberships.membership
ORDER BY Fridays.week_of_month, Memberships.membership;
```

complexity.notes: Fixed eight-row calendar cross join with aggregated purchase sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner joins omit Fridays and memberships where zero purchases occurred.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for the calendar grid.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use cross join and left join to ensure all eight required output rows are present.

WITH RECURSIVE Fridays AS (
    SELECT 1 AS week_of_month, DATE '2023-11-03' AS purchase_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT week_of_month + 1, (purchase_date + INTERVAL '7 DAY')::DATE 
    FROM Fridays 
    WHERE week_of_month < 4
), 
Memberships AS (
    SELECT 'Premium' AS membership
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT 'VIP' AS membership
)
SELECT 
    Fridays.week_of_month, 
    Memberships.membership, 
    COALESCE(SUM(Purchases.amount_spend), 0)::INT AS total_amount 
FROM Fridays 
CROSS JOIN Memberships 
LEFT JOIN Users 
    ON Memberships.membership = Users.membership
LEFT JOIN Purchases 
    ON Fridays.purchase_date = Purchases.purchase_date 
    AND Users.user_id = Purchases.user_id
GROUP BY Fridays.week_of_month, Memberships.membership
ORDER BY Fridays.week_of_month, Memberships.membership;

import pandas as pd

def friday_purchase_iii(purchases: pd.DataFrame, users: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    fridays = [(1, '2023-11-03'), (2, '2023-11-10'), (3, '2023-11-17'), (4, '2023-11-24')]
    memberships = ['Premium', 'VIP']
    grid = []
    for w, d in fridays:
        for m in memberships:
            grid.append({'week_of_month': w, 'purchase_date': d, 'membership': m})
    base = pd.DataFrame(grid)

    p = purchases.copy()
    p['purchase_date'] = pd.to_datetime(p['purchase_date']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    u = users.copy()
    u = u[u['membership'].isin(['Premium', 'VIP'])]
    merged_p = p.merge(u, on='user_id', how='inner')

    agg = merged_p.groupby(['purchase_date', 'membership'])['amount_spend'].sum().reset_index()
    res = base.merge(agg, on=['purchase_date', 'membership'], how='left')
    res['total_amount'] = res['amount_spend'].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return res[['week_of_month', 'membership', 'total_amount']].sort_values(by=['week_of_month', 'membership'])
